title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business from your own 3D office, build the squad and the stadium, and change tactics while you watch the match. Play a whole career, on your phone, even offline.

title: The Whip
summary: A political career game for your phone. Start as a rookie backbench MP in the 120-seat House of Commons of the made-up Dominion of Caledor and climb to Chief Whip: the person who counts the votes, makes the deals and gets the caucus into the chamber when it matters. Every MP remembers what you promised.
